cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
Dock Reservations for commercial use of the 100' dock at Seaforth Boat Rental - Glorietta Bay.

Vessels must be registered with Seaforth with a current Port of San Diego lease, and insurance information provided to Seaforth Boat Rental.

Docking is available for 30 minute periods for guest pick up and drop off.
what_is_included:
PLEASE CREATE TWO RESERVATIONS - One for guest pick up and a second for guest drop off. Selecting the "drop off" option will not add additional charge.

Base rate includes up to 25 passengers. Please select the drop down for additional passenger count.

Passenger counts are subject to audit. Adjustments to passengers must be made 3 days prior to the reservation date.

Bookings can be cancelled or rescheduled using the link from the confirmation email.
